note: Scene subjects: wide frames in the vibe's material and light, no single centred object, no people, no text. A vibe without a list draws on the default list. Grown with `xenoform stills grow <vibe> --kind scene`, listed with kind: scene, and used by the Simple make body's scene_stills choice (mix, only).
